name: Tooltip
summary: Brief label revealed on hover or focus.

props.name: children
props.description: The trigger, as a single element. It receives aria-describedby pointing at the popup — that reference is what makes the hint exist for a screen reader instead of only for the eye. When the element is not focusable on its own (a <span>, a Badge), it becomes focusable, as a button — as in the reference library — so the tip opens from the keyboard too (C-11).

props.name: content
props.description: The hint. Short, and never the only place the information lives: a tooltip is a description, and it must hold nothing focusable.

props.name: side
props.description: Preferred side; it flips when there is no room.

props.name: arrow
props.description: The arrow, off by default as in the reference library. Our own curve, 12 × 6, with the surface fill and the border line.

props.name: delay
props.description: Milliseconds the pointer rests before it opens — the reference library's 1.5 s (the engine's own is 0.6 s). From the keyboard it opens at once, and once one is open its neighbours open without waiting.

props.name: closeDelay
props.description: Milliseconds before it closes after the pointer leaves — the reference library's 0.5 s.
